variables.name: PUBLIC_LVBT_CWA_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Existing shared Labs Web Analytics property token embedded by retained production builds. Preview host gates exclude collection.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEWS_ENABLED
variables.purpose: Explicit switch for existing pull-request preview workflow.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Publishes reviewed retained Labs releases after explicit promotion.
steps: Preserve the existing Labs production environment token.
If missing, obtain the approved production Worker deployment token from its maintainer-owned credential store; do not copy the preview token.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Uploads isolated Labs staging and existing pull-request previews.
steps: Preserve the existing Labs preview environment token and its independent value.
If missing, obtain the approved separate preview credential scoped to the reviewed staging Workers; do not copy the production token.

secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID
secrets.purpose: Identifies the service credential for protected Labs staging verification.
steps: Review the Access service-auth policy for both declared Labs staging Workers and their version preview hostnames.
Copy the approved preview service token client ID from the maintainer credential store.

secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Authorizes protected Labs staging marker and browser verification.
steps: Review the service token and Access policy with the responsible maintainer; create or rotate only through the approved process.
Copy the stored preview service-token secret.

secrets.name: LVBT_MIGRATION_GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Optional read-only cross-repository credential for checking destination deployment ownership during retained handoff recovery. Ordinary Labs releases use the workflow token.
steps: A maintainer supplies an approved fine-grained read-only token with Variables read permission for the exact destination repositories.
Store it as this production environment secret only when a handoff needs cross-repository read access. Do not copy any deployment token; this guard must never write destination ownership.
secrets.neededFor: Retained recovery of a paused handoff when the default workflow token cannot read destination deployment ownership.
